title: sliceModel
body:
## sliceModel

Slices one closed STL part into layer-by-layer FFF/FDM G-code with PrusaSlicer 2.9.6, using a complete configuration rendered from the declared printer, filament and print values. Publishes model.gcode, a per-layer layers.csv, slice-summary.json with native print-time and filament estimates, and the exact config.ini. An independent replay checks layers, the extrusion envelope, temperature/fan setpoints, feedrates, filament arithmetic and kinematic time bounds, and a fresh native reload must reproduce the G-code. It never sends G-code to a printer.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The G-code targets a generic Marlin 2 machine; it is not validated for any physical printer, firmware or material, and no print quality or safety is certified.
- Only one closed STL object; no supports, brim, skirt, raft, multi-material, modifiers or mesh repair.
- Estimates are PrusaSlicer model estimates under the declared machine limits, not measured print times.

Native binding: `PrusaSlicer console --export-gcode`. Output kind: `["text","table"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | The part to slice: an absolute STL path, the units its coordinates use, and optionally the SHA-256 of the exact bytes you intend to slice. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"file":{"type":"string","minLength":2,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"units":{"type":"enum","values":["millimetre","inch"],"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64}}}` | **required** |
| `printer` | A generic Marlin 2 fused-filament machine described only by these values: rectangular bed, maximum print height, nozzle diameter, and the feedrate and acceleration limits used by the native time estimator. It is not a vendor printer profile and nothing is sent to a machine. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"bedSize_mm":{"type":"array","minItems":2,"maxItems":2,"required":true,"items":{"type":"number","minimum":50,"maximum":1000}},"maxPrintHeight_mm":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":10,"maximum":1000},"nozzleDiameter_mm":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0.15,"maximum":1.2},"gcodeFlavour":{"type":"enum","values":["marlin2"],"required":true},"maxFeedrate_mm_s":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":20,"maximum":1000},"maxAcceleration_mm_s2":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":100,"maximum":30000}}}` | **required** |
| `material` | Filament description and setpoints: polymer label, filament diameter and density, first-layer and later nozzle and bed temperatures and the part-cooling fan. The values are copied into G-code and checked for application, not for suitability. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"type":{"type":"enum","values":["PLA","PETG","ABS","ASA"],"required":true},"filamentDiameter_mm":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":1.0,"maximum":3.5},"density_g_cm3":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0.5,"maximum":3.0},"nozzleTemperature_C":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":150,"maximum":320},"firstLayerNozzleTemperature_C":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":150,"maximum":320},"bedTemperature_C":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0,"maximum":130},"firstLayerBedTemperature_C":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0,"maximum":130},"fanSpeed_percent":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0,"maximum":100}}}` | **required** |
| `print` | Process settings: layer heights, one extrusion width for all features, shells, sparse infill and speeds. Supports, brim, skirt, raft, ironing, variable layer height and custom G-code are always off. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"layerHeight_mm":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0.04,"maximum":1.0},"firstLayerHeight_mm":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0.04,"maximum":1.0},"extrusionWidth_mm":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0.15,"maximum":2.4},"perimeters":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":10,"required":true},"topSolidLayers":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":30,"required":true},"bottomSolidLayers":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":30,"required":true},"infillDensity_percent":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0,"maximum":100},"infillPattern":{"type":"enum","values":["rectilinear","grid","gyroid"],"required":true},"perimeterSpeed_mm_s":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":5,"maximum":500},"infillSpeed_mm_s":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":5,"maximum":500},"firstLayerSpeed_mm_s":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":5,"maximum":200},"travelSpeed_mm_s":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":10,"maximum":1000}}}` | **required** |
| `placement` | Where the model sits on the bed. The model is always dropped onto the bed (minimum Z = 0) and never rotated or arranged. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"centre_mm":{"type":"array","minItems":2,"maxItems":2,"items":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1000}}}}` | `{}` |
| `requirements` | Optional named upper limits on checked native estimates. A slice that exceeds any limit still publishes its verified evidence but fails with PERFORMANCE_NOT_MET, which blocks downstream consumers and reuse. | `{"type":"array","maxItems":8,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64,"required":true},"quantity":{"type":"enum","values":["printTime_s","filamentMass_g","filamentLength_mm"],"required":true},"maximum":{"type":"number","required":true,"minimum":0,"maximum":1000000000.0}}}}` | `[]` |
